headline: LLM-built simple baselines recover much of published deep-learning gains across 36 scientific prediction tasks
summary: An October 28 arXiv preprint reports that one Claude Opus 5 workflow constructed supervised prediction baselines across 36 tasks reconstructed from selected open-access papers in Nature-, Science- and Cell-family journals. Across task medians, the authors report a median simple-baseline strength of 95.5% and a mean of 85.7%; on 12 tasks the median baseline matched or exceeded the published deep-learning score. The result is a bounded author-reported audit of predictive contributions, not evidence that the source studies are invalid or that predictive accuracy captures interpretability or scientific insight.
